question: Will Solana (SOL) be trading above $110 at market close on September 1, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the SOL-USD spot price on Coinbase is strictly greater than $110.00 at the market's closing time (Sep 1, 2026, 13:53 UTC).
- "No": Wins if the SOL-USD spot price on Coinbase is $110.00 or below at the market's closing time (Sep 1, 2026, 13:53 UTC).
